title: Warm Mediterranean Egg Frittata
description: A crowd-pleasing Mediterranean dish featuring free-range eggs and wood-fired baking, this frittata is a perfect umami and aerated treat for any meal. It is jain-friendly and made in a hot pot vessel.
instructions: Preheat the wood-fired oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the beaten eggs and a pinch of salt.
Add the sliced olives, chopped artichoke hearts, and sun-dried tomatoes to the bowl and stir to combine.
Pour the egg mixture into a hot pot vessel coated with a small amount of oil.
Sprinkle the crumbled feta cheese and chopped parsley over the top of the egg mixture.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Bake the frittata in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until the eggs are set and the cheese is golden brown.
Remove the frittata from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before slicing and serving.
Serve the frittata warm, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
